PANews, September 11 - President of Sberbank: sees huge opportunities for bilateral trade settlements between India and Russia under the CBDC framework. Most of India's oil purchases from Russia are settled in Indian rupees. Russian enterprises no longer face the problem of excessive accumulation of rupees, and payments can be made in national currencies.
